name: boolean-query-input
title: Boolean Query Input
description: Shows how the engine groups AND and OR (implied brackets highlighted) and offers the grouping you meant; catches unclosed quotes and brackets, curly quotes, [ ] used as brackets, lowercase and/or and dangling operators, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Boolean search returns the wrong people
meta.summary: Shows how a search engine will group AND and OR in a boolean query, so a search doesn't quietly return the wrong people.
catches: Mixed AND/OR without brackets, read back with the engine's implied grouping
Unclosed quotes or brackets, and curly quotes
Square brackets used instead of parentheses
Lowercase and/or that engines search as words
Dangling operators at the start or end
limits: Assumes AND binds first unless you set precedence; engines differ
Does not know engine-specific syntax beyond AND, OR, NOT, quotes and brackets
a11y: Visible <label>; the input is described by the readback and status
Fix buttons have aria-labels with the exact query they apply
